summary: One crumb. A link to an ancestor, or the current page rendered as text.
useWhen: inside a Breadcrumb, once per level

useInstead.why: the crumb's density, colour and truncation are tuned for a trail and look wrong on their own

children.note: the name of the level, not its path

requires: `isCurrent` on the last crumb, which renders it as text with aria-current="page" rather than as a link
notes: isCurrent is a prop rather than inferred from position: a trail whose last crumb legitimately links elsewhere exists, and inferring would break it

antiPatterns.dont: <BreadcrumbItem href="/invoices/12">Invoice 12</BreadcrumbItem> for the page you are on
antiPatterns.why: a link to the current page is a dead control — it announces as a link, invites a click and does nothing
